description: Cast a tropical natal chart. Returns each planet with its sign, degree, retrograde flag, and whole-sign house, plus the ascendant, midheaven, twelve houses, and major aspects. Without a birth time the rising sign and houses are omitted. Example: birth_date 1990-07-04, birth_time 14:30, latitude 40.7128, longitude -74.006, timezone America/New_York.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as HH:MM, 24-hour. Omit it when the time is unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees, from -89.9 to 89.9. North is positive.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180. East is positive.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.

name: natal_chart
